Author: Lénile
Name: DressRoulette
Punchline: A daily glamour theme, the same for everyone. Dress up, share with #DressRoulette.
Description:
DressRoulette gives you one glamour theme per day, the same for every player, changing at the daily reset.
Build your outfit around it, then share it with #DressRoulette.

- Daily theme and an optional bonus constraint
- Free wheel to spin as often as you like, with your own themes
- Sharing streak, best streak, streak-saving jokers and a calendar of your last days
- Optional reminder of today's theme in your chat (only you can see it)
- French and English

DressRoulette never changes your outfit and sends nothing over the internet. The share button only copies a text to your clipboard and opens a Discord channel in your browser.

AI disclosure: the English translations were made with AI assistance. The icon was made by hand, without AI.
